title: csv_create_sales
prompt: Create or overwrite datauser/test_spreadsheet/sales.csv with columns Month,Region,Units,Revenue. Include 24 data rows: one for each month in both North and South, ordered North then South for each month. Use positive whole-number Units and Revenue. Save the file, report its full path and that it contains 24 data rows, and show the exact header and first three data rows as CSV text.
